prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Cloud Pet Restore Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores all previously adopted pets and cloud progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically restores your saved pets and progress from previous sessions."}}
1: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Hotkey Action Center Redesign: Redesign the home intro welcome section to include a prominent hotkey checklist showing core pet actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "text": "Quick Hotkeys: Press Alt+P to toggle visibility, Alt+H to hide, Alt+C to open chat", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Quick Hotkey Interactive Desktop Guide Screen: Add a dedicated desktop hotkey reference screen at the finish step before launching the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_hotkey_guide"], "new_hotkey_guide": {"headline": "Master Desktop Pet Hotkeys", "body": "Try out your pet controls so you can interact with your companion effortlessly.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Alt+P: Show/Hide Pet | Alt+M: Mute Audio | Alt+C: Chat Box", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Preparation Status Info: Display explicit status info and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets initialize.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "hint": "Preparing high-res desktop animations. Your pet will launch automatically in moments."}}
4: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Customization Trait Processing Wait Info: Add progress updates and estimated wait time during photo upload processing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Analyzing photo features and building pet behaviors... Processing takes around 1-2 minutes."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Account Sync Hint: Show a clear reassurance hint during sign-in stating that pets sync automatically across all user devices.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your pet progress and customizations automatically transfer across all signed-in devices."}}
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Setup Flow: Insert a short interactive setup flow at the end of onboarding for practicing basic pet controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_interaction_flow"], "new_interaction_flow": {"headline": "Practice Controlling Your Pet", "body": "Test your hotkeys now to summon, hide, or chat with your new pet.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Test Summon (Alt+P)", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
7: [choose_path, reorder] Choose Path First Sequence Reorder: Move path selection ahead of the story introduction screen so users choose their companion path immediately.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready System Notification: Enable desktop system notifications when background pet rendering finishes during the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to appear on your desktop."}}
9: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Security and Pet Memory Hint: Add sign-in copy confirming that user accounts safely retain pet personality data and certificate records.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your adoption certificate and preserves pet personality data safe in the cloud."}}
